articles.summary: Exclusive five-year license brings Jockey ® underwear and apparel to Indonesian consumers dedicated e-commerce, leading marketplaces and BrilliA’s retail and wholesale distribution network BrilliA Incorporated (NYSE American: BRIA) (“BrilliA” or the “Company”) today announced the official launch of Jockey ® branded products in Indonesia through its Indonesia operating company, PT. Mirae Asia Pasifik. The launch marks the commencement of BrilliA’s exclusive five-year Trademark License Agreement with Jockey International, Inc. (“Jockey”) announced in June 2026, and represents the introduction of the brand to Indonesian consumers. Jockey products are now available in Indonesia through the brand’s dedicated Indonesian website, jockey.id , official storefronts on Tokopedia and Shopee, and PT. Mirae Asia Pasifik’s retail and wholesale distribution network. The Company is also supporting the launch through Jockey Indonesia’s official Instagram channel, @jockey_indonesia , which will feature
articles.title: BrilliA Incorporated Launches Jockey® in Indonesia, Expanding Brand Partnership into One of Southeast Asia’s Largest Consumer Markets
